name: Screenshot Service
description: Headless browser screenshot service for capturing, validating, comparing, and publishing dashboard screenshots

tools.name: List Screenshot Pages
tools.description: List known dashboard pages from the screenshot page registry. Shows page IDs, titles, paths, and last capture status.

filter.description: Filter by page ID, title, or tag

instructions.summary: Browse available pages for screenshot capture
when_to_use: User asks what pages can be captured
User wants to see screenshot status
Before capturing, to find the right page_id

tools.name: Capture Screenshot
tools.description: Take a screenshot of a specific dashboard page using a headless browser. Stores the image for comparison or upload.

wait_for.description: CSS selector to wait for before capturing

full_page.description: Capture the full scrollable page (default: false)

instructions.summary: Capture a dashboard page screenshot with a headless browser
when_to_use: User asks to take/update a screenshot
User says 'capture the assistants page'
Part of a gallery refresh workflow
when_not_to_use: User wants to view existing screenshots (use the gallery)
The page hasn't changed (check with screencap.compare first)

tools.name: Compare Screenshots
tools.description: Compare the latest capture of a page against the previously stored version. Returns the pixel difference percentage and a recommendation (upload/review/skip).

instructions.summary: Detect visual changes by comparing screenshots pixel-by-pixel
when_to_use: After capturing a new screenshot, before uploading
To check if a page has visually changed
Part of automated gallery refresh

tools.name: Validate Screenshot
tools.description: Check screenshot quality — validates dimensions, file size, blank page detection, and error overlay detection.

page_id.description: Page identifier to validate the latest capture of

instructions.summary: Quality check a captured screenshot before publishing
when_to_use: After capturing, before uploading to the gallery
If a previous upload looked wrong
Part of automated gallery refresh

tools.name: Upload Screenshot
tools.description: Upload the latest capture of a page to the quox.ai website gallery with metadata (title, description, tags, featured flag).

title.description: Gallery display title (defaults to page title from registry)

instructions.summary: Publish a screenshot to the quox.ai product gallery
when_to_use: After capturing and validating a screenshot
User says 'upload the screenshot for assistants'
Part of automated gallery refresh when diff > threshold

tools.name: Screenshot Status
tools.description: Check the status of all pages in the registry — shows last capture time, staleness, and capture counts.

max_age_days.description: Days before a page is considered stale

instructions.summary: Check which pages need new screenshots
when_to_use: User asks 'which pages need updating?'
Before a batch refresh
To check gallery freshness

instructions.summary: Capture, validate, compare, and publish dashboard screenshots for the quox.ai gallery
when_to_use: User wants to update product screenshots
User asks to capture a dashboard page
Automated gallery refresh workflow
User says 'update the screenshot for X'
when_not_to_use: User wants to view the gallery (direct them to quox.ai/gallery)
User wants to edit/design the dashboard UI

typical_workflow: 1. screencap.status() — Check which pages are stale
5. screencap.upload(page_id, title, tags) — Publish to gallery
